name: What common types of damage necessitate garage drywall repair?

mainEntity.name: What common types of damage necessitate garage drywall repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Garage drywall can suffer from various types of damage due to its functional environment. Common issues include cracks from settling, holes from impacts or shelving installation, water damage from roof leaks or plumbing issues, and general wear and tear. Pest infestations can also compromise drywall integrity, requiring repair or replacement. Addressing these problems promptly helps maintain the garage's structural integrity and appearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common garage drywall damage includes cracks, holes, water damage, and pest-related issues.
